name: Tao Ren
headline: Building reliable agents for real-world work.
intro: I'm Tao Ren (Tempest), an independent researcher and senior full-stack engineer working at the intersection of LLM research, agent systems, and production software.
summary: I build systems that connect model capabilities to tools, documents, and the constraints of a real workflow. My interests include structured code generation, precise editing, evaluation, and human review. I care about what happens after a model produces an answer: whether the result is useful, testable, and reliable enough to use.

current.summary: An internal AI coworker for insurance operators. I work on document-heavy workflows, generated contracts, company-style email drafts, tool use, and human-in-the-loop review.
current.detail: A task can involve more than 50 PDFs alongside policy and submission documents. The engineering challenge is to coordinate those files and internal services while respecting permissions, domain constraints, and operator review. My work on quoting and placement services also informs how I design the agent around the insurance workflow.
